title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager Job description

Double Nines works with our clients to conceive, plan, create, and deliver modern digital products and platforms for evolving businesses. We are creative in our approach to all challenges and are looking for intelligent, motivated, and engaging people to join and help lead our team.

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our growing team and make an immediate impact. We are a global company specializing in digital product innovation. Double Nines works with large companies, startups, and agencies. The successful candidate will lead the development of web platforms and/or mobile applications.

This role will work cross-functionally with teams at Double Nines to champion features that enable innovative experiences for end customers. We are looking for someone who is comfortable owning a product and driving product initiatives.


Responsibilities

●  Serve as the primary driver for identifying opportunities and roadmapping the company's future while considering organizational strategy and goals.

●  Partner with leadership in product direction, feature definition, and customer experience decisions.

●  Own a product roadmap prioritizing impactful, customer-focused solutions that align with company goals and customer needs.

●  Define how we measure success as we grow and evolve the platform.

● Manage and anticipate delays, bottlenecks, or breakdowns in process, escalating as needed and helping make decisions to balance need vs. constraints. 

●  Be a collaborative and empathic team player and resource, and represent the team’s work and effort with leadership, customers, and partners.

Requirements

●  Demonstrated success leading product feature definition, planning software release cycles, owning product roadmaps, prioritizing team effort, and efficiently communicating with cross-functional groups to release products and features.

● 2- 4+ years of product management experience owning innovative consumer-facing product features and experiences or experience in a related field.

●  Ability to direct the efforts of subject matter experts to define high-level business and product requirements as they relate to organizational goals and priorities.

●  Technical aptitude, an ability to understand software architecture diagrams, challenges, and risks, and an interest in the latest trends in digital marketplaces.

●  Strong project management skills and excellent organizational and communication skills. Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
